test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only 1 person sits to the left of D. A is an immediate neighbour of D. Only 2 people sit between F and D. Only 3 people sit between C and G. B is not an immediate neighbour of G. Only 2 people sit between E and A.

Who sits to the immediate right of G?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Only 1 person sits to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b6fffca78436fe6c90d967f1320735d2fb66d3d5b07d13cdd24aec197a13364.png] 

2) Only 2 people sit between F and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91894cfbdba032d26d4a1264cf92975319783010c17266c55623a601ac8e432a.png] 

3) A is an immediate neighbour of D.

4) Only 2 people sit between E and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b436ec4407184fc8172a4d983e387607013356b9c458a55a886af0a63488c3.png] 

5) Only 3 people sit between C and G.

6) B is not an immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b469912625cb81809e5613edea8990da4b0301a63cc0ca94b0216b1e7122316.png] 

Here, we can see that E sits to the immediate right of G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"E"**.
